page.text:
The natural numbers $\mathbb{N} = \{0, 1, 2, \dots\}$ are the
foundational numbers of discrete counting and order. Arising intuitively
from the rhythm of succession, they form the archetype of inductive
systems. Rather than treating counting numbers as unexamined primitives,
modern foundational mathematics axiomatizes their essential dynamics: a
single starting point and a repeatable forward progression that never
cycles and never merges.
